Born in 1943, a native of Ilan, Taiwan. In 1969 he graduated from Fu-Shing Art and Vocational School, and in 1975 graduated with an Art major from the National Taiwan Normal University. In 1989 he attended UCLA Art Extension and from 1989 to 1990 attended Art Center College of Design in Pasadena.

From 1960 he exhibited at the Tai Yang Fine Arts Show and the Province-Wide Fine Art Show over many years. In 1963 he won prizes at the Taiwan Fine Art Youth Exhibition. In 1964 he won First Place in Chinese Painting at an exhibition by Army Corps of Ilan. In 1974 at the National Taiwan Normal University Department of Fine Arts he won 1st Place in Cubism designs, 1st Place in Sculpture, 1st Place in Artdeco designs, and 2nd Place in Water Color Painting.

In 1976 he served as an instructor at the University of Chinese Culture. Also in 1976 he became President of Q-Art Enterprises Company. In 1979 he immigrated to the U.S.A. and settled in Los Angeles. In 1984 he became a member of the North America Taiwanese Writers and Artists Association (N.A.T.W.A.A.), and in 1985 a member of the San Gabriel Fine Arts Association. In 1990 he was invited by the Southern California Taiwan United Fund (S.C.T.U.F.) to hold a personal oil painting exhibition, and received the North America Taiwanese Writers & Artists Association Art Success Achievement Award.
